description: Buffer Overflow in the data receiving process in NEC Corporation WebSAM WinShare Ver 7.5.0 and earlier, Ver 7.6.0 and Ver 7.7.0 through 7.7.2 on Windows allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges via a crafted packet with a malformed data size value in the protocol header.

enisaIdProduct.product_version: Ver 7.5.0 and earlier, Ver 7.6.0 and Ver 7.7.0 through 7.7.2
